findings: Sampled examples have artificial author commentary (la ficha no trae entrada por Herveo; no inventes un sendero; 140 km no es mi recorrido desde Bogotá; altura del centro, no de la cumbre). Rewrite all 80 topics with real visitor queries, including colloquial and typo forms; no source-report narration as positives.

control_coordinates short is a dense multi-point coordinate table, unsuitable default. Ask/need the relevant access point or give brief overview with historical date; put individual published coordinates in structured steps/detail, each still sourced and dated.

bus_or_van_entry infers admission permission from a fee category. Do not equate the fee table with present road/vehicle authorization; reconcile the current Tolima restriction with park vehicle categories without inventing one rule.

from_bogota short overexplains irrelevant straight-line 140 km. Give sector-specific approach and final junction, place source-distance warning in optional detail, never imply reaching Manizales city is necessary before a Letras turnoff.
el_cisne_approach mixes service availability and altitude with navigation. Keep route focus, transfer accommodation query/answer to services and altitude intent to geography as appropriate.
no_published_gate_towns should not instruct a specific detour based solely on absence of a published route. Say no verified route is held and direct to official sector entrances/registered operator.
All current road/parking/vehicle restrictions must retain temporal caveats in independently served variants. Historical 2023 coordinates are not guaranteed current checkpoints.
